A14 A TAB THAT KEPT NOTHING FINDS THE PAYMENT AGAIN: without a stored request /payment sends the customer to checkout, checkout says a payment is in progress and offers "Go to payment", and the payment page reads the checkout the backend names and shows the VERIFIED payment — nothing is started
B1 CANCEL: the page reports "cancelled" (nothing else), the backend asks the provider — no payment there — and answers CANCELLED with its own safe words; the page offers to try again and to go back
B2 THE CHECKOUT IS RECOVERABLE: after the cancellation it is READY again, its pickup hold is still held, the attempt is CANCELLED and no money is recorded
B3 RETRY IS A NEW ATTEMPT with a new provider order: attempt 2, another id and another provider order reference, the same amount; the first attempt stays CANCELLED
B4 FAILED: the backend asks the provider, finds the failed payment and answers FAILED with a category and safe words; the page shows those words — no provider error code — and offers another try

results.name: C3 THE PROVIDER'S EVENT SETTLES IT: the bank confirms later, the provider sends a signed event, the backend verifies the payment — the page (asking the backend, 2 status reads) shows VERIFIED; the device never reported a success and no report was posted
C4 the payment's timeline shows where the truth came from: the attempt, the provider, the pending state, the provider's event and the verification

D1 THE DEVICE NEVER HEARD BACK: the customer paid, the provider's window told the page nothing — the page asks the backend, the backend finds the captured payment (the provider's event and its own look at the provider) and the page shows VERIFIED; no success was ever reported by the device

E1 A WEBHOOK WITHOUT A VALID SIGNATURE IS REFUSED (401 webhook_signature_invalid): unsigned, wrongly signed, a body changed by one byte after signing — and a customer session does not make it valid; nothing was stored and the attempt is unchanged
E2 A SIGNED WEBHOOK NEEDS NO CUSTOMER SESSION: sent without any Authorization header it is accepted (200, 343 ms), handled on the queue, and the payment becomes VERIFIED — the device reported nothing
E3 THE SAME EVENT AGAIN IS A DUPLICATE: answered 200 "duplicate", counted on the one stored event (deliveries 2), processed once — the payment is VERIFIED once
E4 A LATE "FAILED" EVENT CANNOT UNDO A VERIFIED PAYMENT: it is accepted and recorded, and the attempt stays VERIFIED (a verified payment never goes back)
E5 the endpoint refuses what it should: a body over the size limit (413), an unknown provider (404) — and what is kept of an event is a summary of safe fields, never the raw message
F1 OWNERSHIP: another signed-in customer cannot read, complete or simulate this payment, nor start one for this checkout (404 — it does not exist for them); without a session every call is 401

F2 TAMPERING: a start that carries an amount, a currency, a status, an owner, a provider, a secret or card details is refused as a whole (422, each field named) and creates nothing; a start for another price than the confirmed one is refused (409 checkout_stale)
F3 a report that carries a status or an amount is refused (422) and an outcome the API does not know is refused (422); the attempt is untouched
G1 STARTING AGAIN GIVES THE SAME ATTEMPT: the same key, another key — every answer is the one open attempt (200), and the checkout has ONE attempt and one provider order

G2 FOUR REPORTS AT ONCE AND THE PROVIDER'S EVENT TWICE: every report is answered (200,200,200,200), the payment is VERIFIED exactly once (one "verified" in its timeline), the event is stored once with two deliveries

H1 THE PROVIDER CAPTURED ANOTHER AMOUNT THAN OURS: the payment is NOT verified — REVIEW_REQUIRED (PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH) — the page says it is being checked, gives the support reference, warns not to pay again and offers nothing to pay
H2 the checkout stays locked while a person has to look: another start is refused (409, a payment is in progress) — no second payment beside money that may have moved
